Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Coffee Table, 39.37"W, Pine Veneer and Natural Wood
Colors: Natural
Materials: Pine
Constructed with simple miter joints and straight lines, this pine veneer coffee table in a natural color offers a sleek look. The moderate size allows plenty of room for magazines, coffee cups, and, of course, feet. Enjoy relaxing while the table adds comfort and functionality to any room. 39.37"W x 21.65"D x 16.54"H 85% MDF, 10% solid pine, 5% pine veneer The simple design brings a modern look to this coffee table. The pine veneer in a natural color comes together with miter joints to create a sleek-looking contemporary coffee table. No assembly required Wipe with a soft, damp cloth; dry thoroughly. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
